name: Yandex Metrica
description: Let your AI analyse Yandex Metrica web analytics: counters, goals, filters and segments, table, time-series, drill-down and comparison reports on visits, sources, pages and conversions, and raw visits and hits through the Logs API.
instructions:
## Yandex Metrica
This connector uses the **Yandex Metrica API** (`https://api-metrika.yandex.net`) with an OAuth token: the Management API (counters, goals, filters, operations, segments, access), the Reporting API (tables, time series, drill-down and comparisons, sampled and fast) and the Logs API (raw unsampled visits and hits).

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. Create an app at https://oauth.yandex.com (For API access or debugging) with the access **metrika:read** (Metrica statistics, counter settings, list of counters). Note its ClientID.
2. Signed in with the Yandex account that owns or can see the counters, open `https://oauth.yandex.com/authorize?response_type=token&client_id=<ClientID>` and copy the token (it starts with `y0_`) into `YANDEX_METRICA_TOKEN`. It is sent as `Authorization: OAuth ...`, is valid for about a year and is extended while it is used.
3. Creating Logs API requests also works with metrika:read; nothing in this connector changes counters or goals.

**Where to start**: `yandex_metrica_list_counters` for the counter ids (`ids` in reports, `counterId` elsewhere), then `yandex_metrica_list_goals` for goal ids, then the reports.

**Reports**
- `yandex_metrica_get_report`: a table. Metrics and dimensions use the `ym:s:` prefix for sessions (visits) and `ym:pv:` for pageviews; e.g. `metrics=ym:s:visits,ym:s:users,ym:s:bounceRate`, `dimensions=ym:s:lastTrafficSource`. Goal metrics embed the goal id: `ym:s:goal123reaches`, `ym:s:goal123conversionRate`. Dates take `YYYY-MM-DD`, `today`, `yesterday` or `30daysAgo`. Filters use `==`, `!=`, `=@` (contains), `=~` (regex) combined with AND/OR, e.g. `ym:s:lastTrafficSource=='organic'`.
- `yandex_metrica_get_report_by_time`: the same metrics per day, week or month (`group`) for the top `top_keys` rows.
- `yandex_metrica_get_drilldown`: expand a dimension tree row by row with `parent_id`.
- `yandex_metrica_compare_segments`: segment or period A against B (`date1_a`/`date2_a`, `date1_b`/`date2_b`, `filters_a`/`filters_b`).
- Answers include `sampled` and `sample_share`: when sampled is true the figures are estimates; pass `accuracy` full for exact figures on small ranges, or use the Logs API.
- Rows page with `limit` (default 100, at most 100,000) and `offset` (from 1).

**Settings**: `yandex_metrica_get_counter`, `yandex_metrica_get_goal`, `yandex_metrica_list_filters`, `yandex_metrica_list_operations`, `yandex_metrica_list_segments` (saved segment expressions to reuse as `filters`), `yandex_metrica_list_grants`, `yandex_metrica_list_labels`.

**Logs API (raw data)**: `yandex_metrica_evaluate_log_request` (can it be built?), `yandex_metrica_create_log_request`, then poll `yandex_metrica_get_log_request` or `yandex_metrica_list_log_requests` until status is `processed`, then `yandex_metrica_download_log_part` for each part (tab-separated text). `yandex_metrica_cancel_log_request` stops a pending request; `yandex_metrica_clean_log_request` (switched off at install) deletes prepared files to free the log quota. Log date ranges cannot include today.

**Limits**: 5,000 requests a day per user, 200 report requests per 5 minutes per user, 3 parallel requests per user, 30 per second per IP (10 for the Logs API); 429 when exceeded. Errors: 401 a wrong or expired token, 403 no access to that counter, 400 an invalid metric, dimension or filter (the message names it).

**Out of scope**: creating or editing counters, goals, filters and access; uploading offline conversions, calls, expenses, user parameters or CRM data.
prerequisites: A Yandex account with access to the Metrica counters, an app on oauth.yandex.com with the metrika:read access, and an OAuth token for that account. About 5 minutes.

YANDEX_METRICA_TOKEN.label: OAuth token
YANDEX_METRICA_TOKEN.help: Open https://oauth.yandex.com/authorize?response_type=token&client_id=<your ClientID> signed in with the account that sees the counters, and copy the token (starts with y0_). The app needs metrika:read.
YANDEX_METRICA_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token (it usually starts with y0_), without OAuth or Bearer.

verifyHints.401: Yandex Metrica refused the token: it is wrong, expired or revoked. Get a new one at oauth.yandex.com with your app's ClientID.
verifyHints.403: The token works, but its account has no access to this counter, or the app lacks metrika:read.
verifyHints.429: A Yandex Metrica quota is used up (5,000 requests a day, 200 reports per 5 minutes). Wait and verify again.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_list_counters
tools.description: List the Metrica counters (tags) the token can read: id, name, site, status, owner_login, permission (own, view, edit), time zone, creation date and, with field, goals, mirrors, grants, filters, operations. Start here to get counter ids; also checks the token.

search_string.description: Substring of the counter name or site, or a full counter id.

permission.description: Comma-separated access levels: own, view, edit.

type.description: simple (created in Metrica) or partner (imported from YAN).

field.description: Extra blocks, comma-separated: goals, mirrors, grants, filters, operations, counter_flags.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_get_counter
tools.description: Get one counter's settings: name, site and mirrors, status, time zone, code status, webvisor and e-commerce options, owner and, with field, goals, grants, filters and operations.

field.description: Extra blocks, comma-separated: goals, mirrors, grants, filters, operation, counter_flags.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_list_goals
tools.description: List the goals of a counter: id, name, type (url, action, number, step, phone, email, form, messenger ...), conditions, is_retargeting and default price. Use the goal ids in metrics such as ym:s:goal<id>reaches and ym:s:goal<id>conversionRate.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_get_goal
tools.description: Get one goal of a counter by id: name, type, conditions, steps of a composite goal and price.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_list_filters
tools.description: List the data filters of a counter (include or exclude traffic by IP, URL, title, referrer ...): id, attr, type, value, action, status.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_list_operations
tools.description: List the URL operations of a counter (cut query parameters or fragments, merge to lowercase, replace domain): id, action, attr, value, status.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_list_segments
tools.description: List the saved segments of a counter: segment_id, name, expression (a filter you can pass as filters in reports), status, segment_source and create_time.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_list_grants
tools.description: List who has access to a counter: user_login, perm (view or edit), created_at and comment.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_list_labels
tools.description: List the user's counter labels (folders): id and name. Filter yandex_metrica_list_counters by label_id.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_get_report
tools.description: Build a table report from the Reporting API: metrics grouped by dimensions over a date range, with filters, sorting and paging. Use it for most questions (traffic by source, conversions per goal, top pages, countries, devices). Answer: query, data (rows with dimensions and metrics), totals, min, max, total_rows, sampled and sample_share.

ids.description: Counter id, or several comma-separated, e.g. 44147844.

metrics.description: Comma-separated metrics, at most 20, e.g. ym:s:visits,ym:s:users,ym:s:bounceRate,ym:s:pageDepth,ym:s:avgVisitDurationSeconds,ym:s:goal<goalId>reaches. Required unless preset is given.

dimensions.description: Comma-separated dimensions, at most 10, e.g. ym:s:date, ym:s:lastTrafficSource, ym:s:lastSearchEngine, ym:s:regionCountry, ym:s:deviceCategory, ym:s:startURL.

date1.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD, or today, yesterday, NdaysAgo (e.g. 30daysAgo). Default 6daysAgo.

date2.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, or today, yesterday, NdaysAgo. Default today.

filters.description: Segmentation filter, e.g. ym:s:trafficSource=='organic' AND ym:s:isRobot=='No'.

preset.description: Report preset instead of metrics/dimensions, e.g. sources_summary, sources_search_phrases, traffic, tech_platforms, geo_country.

accuracy.description: Sampling: low, medium, high, full, or a fraction like 0.1. Default: the API's choice.

proposed_accuracy.description: true lets the API raise accuracy automatically for small samples.

include_undefined.description: Include rows whose first dimension is undefined.

direct_client_logins.description: Comma-separated Yandex Direct client logins, for Direct cost reports.

timezone.description: Time zone as +hh:mm or -hh:mm. Default: the counter's.

lang.description: Language of dimension names, e.g. en, ru.

sort.description: Comma-separated metrics or dimensions; prefix - for descending, e.g. -ym:s:visits.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_get_report_by_time
tools.description: Build a time series: the metrics per day, week, month, hour or other interval for the top rows of the dimensions. Use it for trends and charts. Answer: time_intervals and, per row, the metric values per interval, plus totals.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_get_drilldown
tools.description: Build a tree report: the first dimension's values with their metrics, then expand one row into the next dimension with parent_id. Use it to explore a hierarchy (source, then engine, then phrase). Answer: query, data (rows with dimensions and metrics), totals, min, max, total_rows, sampled and sample_share.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_evaluate_log_request
tools.description: Check whether a Logs API request for raw visits or hits can be created: possible (true or false) and max_possible_day_quantity. Call it before yandex_metrica_create_log_request.

fields.description: Comma-separated Logs API fields of the chosen source, e.g. ym:s:visitID,ym:s:dateTime,ym:s:lastTrafficSource,ym:s:goalsID for visits or ym:pv:watchID,ym:pv:dateTime,ym:pv:URL for hits.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_create_log_request
tools.description: Create a Logs API request that prepares raw, unsampled visits or hits for a date range on Yandex's side. Returns the log_request with request_id and status created; poll yandex_metrica_get_log_request until status is processed, then download its parts. Prepared logs count against the counter's log storage quota.

fields.description: Comma-separated Logs API fields of the chosen source, e.g. ym:s:visitID,ym:s:dateTime,ym:s:lastTrafficSource,ym:s:goalsID for visits or ym:pv:watchID,ym:pv:dateTime,ym:pv:URL for hits.

attribution.description: Attribution model for source fields. Default LASTSIGN.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_list_log_requests
tools.description: List the Logs API requests of a counter: request_id, source, fields, attribution, status (created, processed, canceled, processing_failed, awaiting_retry, cleaned_by_user, cleaned_automatically_as_too_old), size and parts.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_get_log_request
tools.description: Get one Logs API request: status and, once processed, the parts (part_number and size) to download.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_download_log_part
tools.description: Download one part of a processed Logs API request as tab-separated text, the first line holding the field names. Parts can be large; download them one at a time and summarise.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_cancel_log_request
tools.description: Cancel a Logs API request that is still being prepared (status created). Returns the request with status canceled.

tools.name: yandex_metrica_clean_log_request
tools.description: Delete the prepared files of a processed Logs API request to free the counter's log storage quota. The files cannot be downloaded afterwards. Irreversible; installed switched off.
